title: FontVibe Rune Transliterator: Latin text to Elder Futhark, Younger Futhark and Anglo-Saxon Futhorc runes
description:
Phonetic transliteration of English and other Latin-alphabet text into three runic alphabets — Elder Futhark (24 runes), Younger Futhark long-branch (16 runes) and Anglo-Saxon Futhorc (32 runes) — and back.

A single JSON file holds the mapping tables (letters, digraphs such as th, ng and ea, rune names and conventional glosses); dependency-free JavaScript (ESM and CommonJS) and Python implementations are generated from it. Both are verified against golden outputs recorded from the implementation behind fontvibe.ai's rune tools, including SHA-256 checks over every Unicode scalar value. All 44 distinct runes are single code points in the Unicode Runic block (U+16A0–U+16FF); the README's charts, code points and Unicode names are generated from unicodedata and checked by a stdlib-only script.

This is a phonetic approximation of modern spelling, not a translation into Old Norse or Old English. Live tools: Elder Futhark, Younger Futhark, Anglo-Saxon futhorc.
